Q01.summary: Renders a nested trusted-publisher form with six labeled text fields (three optional), each with error styling and help text.

Q02.summary: For URL-encoded or untyped requests, defaults the Content-Type header and yields the body unless it is already a string or IO.

Q03.summary: For keyword-style `or`/`and` nodes, flags and autocorrects missing spaces before/after the operator keyword.

Q04.summary: Builds a diff of added, removed (accounting for renames matched by trace) and worsened-magnitude entries between recorded and current snapshots.

Q05.summary: Converts settings loaded from the chosen config file (via --config/--no-config/default) into CLI flag pairs, validating keys and value types.

Q06.summary: Returns the statements inside the single opened root node's body, or the roots themselves otherwise.

Q07.summary: Builds an OIDC access policy with one allow statement per extracted workflow ref, each combining common repository/environment/owner/audience conditions with a job_workflow_ref condition.

Q08.summary: Builds the middleware stack by yielding to a block or adding url_encoded by default, then sets the default adapter if none was set, raising if locked.

Q09.summary: Returns this version's checksums (or content keys) that do not appear in any other version's checksum file for the gem.

Q10.summary: Runs the survivors CLI: loads a report and either shows a single mutant by id or lists mutants of a status filtered by file, returning an exit code.

Q11.summary: Finds the RuboCop config path by checking project dotfile, project .config, user dotfile, XDG config, then falling back to the default.

Q12.summary: Walks a method's nodes tallying calls by receiver (self vs. local variables) and returns the most-referenced local holders unless self ties for most (feature envy).

Q13.summary: Returns provenance metadata saying whether the selected test files are a strict subset of the configured tests, including the configured tests if so.

Q14.summary: Deduplicates mutation variants by comparing the normalized AST each produces when applied at the location, keeping only the first of each distinct result.

Q15.summary: Marks the mutation point schema-unsafe with a reason if it is still safe and falls inside any given unsafe range, returning self.

Q16.summary: Hash-like fetch for an options struct: returns the set value, or sets it from a default argument or block, or raises if absent.

Q17.summary: Decodes a query string with the given or default encoder and merges the params into this hash with string keys.

Q18.summary: Computes a minimal set of top-ranked edges whose removal splits the graph so no strongly connected component exceeds half the members, via binary search then trimming.

Q19.summary: Returns a URL's path with a leading slash plus its query parameters sorted alphabetically.

Q20.summary: Returns true when MFA is recommended for the user's gems (and not already strong or required) but the user has MFA disabled.

Q21.summary: Returns a new Local storage rooted at a subdirectory, raising if the path escapes the base directory.

Q22.summary: Logs the request method and filtered URL, then optionally the filtered headers and body depending on options.

Q23.summary: Fetches a task from the API by id and returns its state, raising on an unsuccessful response.

Q24.summary: Temporarily restricts RSpec example groups (and their children) to only the wanted examples while yielding, restoring them afterwards.

Q25.summary: Parses a raw header string, taking only the last response's headers and adding each key/value (merging duplicates with commas).

Q26.summary: Collects the set of string/symbol words from array elements and hash keys in a syntax tree that match PATTERN.

Q27.summary: Returns whether the node is of a literal type and all its child nodes are recursively literal.

Q28.summary: Returns whether constant usage across clients divides into at least two significant parts (a majority-shared core plus clusters of clients linked by remaining constants).

Q29.summary: Renders the password reset form, requiring MFA first when needed and otherwise marking the reset verified and setting the compromised flag.

Q30.summary: Records the WebAuthn MFA login duration and completes login, tracking success/failure events and redirecting or re-rendering the login form.

Q31.summary: Flags if/unless/ternary/elsif whose branches are boolean literals and autocorrects to the (possibly negated) condition.

Q32.summary: Flags ternaries nested in a ternary and autocorrects the outer ternary into an if/else block.

Q33.summary: Adds test root dirs to the load path, requires the test files, and indexes all Minitest runnable methods by name.

Q34.summary: Creates a request of the given method pre-populated with copies of the connection's params, headers and options, yielding it for customization.

Q35.summary: Recursively collects the condition nodes that steer control flow, not descending into scope fences and skipping and/or nodes used as carried values.

Q36.summary: Returns the coupling graph built from parsed project trees, resolving auto packaging to namespace for Rails or folder otherwise.

Q37.summary: Loads ignore rules from a baseline YAML relative to the config file, symbolizing keys and requiring each to have a file and a non-blank reason.

Q38.summary: Builds a Folding over catalog entries excluding Rails presentation files, with Rails-specific suffixes.

Q39.summary: Encodes params (hash or array of pairs) into a nested query string, recursively handling hashes and arrays with bracket notation.

Q40.summary: Delegates to a lazily built placement to decide whether a package is a web package.

Q41.summary: Builds a timeout MutantResult for the mutant id with its file, duration, and a detail including optional stack dumps.

Q42.summary: Expands CLI-or-configured globs into a sorted, unique list of .rb files, removing excluded ones.

Q43.summary: Flags an initialize method that is empty or only calls super with the same arguments, and autocorrects by removing it.

Q44.summary: Recursively collects [start, end] offset spans of the bodies of hole-type nodes in a syntax tree.

Q45.summary: Runs the worker pool event loop: assigns mutant ids to workers, reads and dispatches their messages, handles requeues and timeouts, until all workers finish.

Q46.summary: Signals a process to dump its stack, waits up to a grace period for the dump file, and returns its contents (deleting it), or nil if the process is gone.

Q47.summary: Flags single-line `in` pattern branches that use a semicolon instead of `then` and autocorrects to `then`.

Q48.summary: Runs the given mutant ids serially or concurrently with progress reporting and returns a RunReport.

Q49.summary: Checks `end` alignment of a case node, using assignment-aware alignment targets when the case is an assigned value.

Q50.summary: Verifies and saves a new WebAuthn credential, rendering a JSON redirect (to recovery codes for first device) or error, and clears registration session data.

Q51.summary: Flags a for loop iterating the same collection as its preceding sibling for loop and autocorrects by merging them.

Q52.summary: Returns findings for methods whose cognitive complexity meets the threshold, ordered by descending score.

Q53.summary: Forks a coverage worker child process connected by request/response pipes and returns its pid, parent pipe ends and stack dumper.

Q54.summary: Rack middleware that signs in the user given by the `as` query param before calling the app.

Q55.summary: Flags multiline ternaries and autocorrects them to a single-line ternary or an if/else, preserving condition comments.

Q56.summary: Categorizes how two node sequences differ: structure mismatch, or the unique kinds of field/value/safe-navigation differences between paired nodes.

Q57.summary: Returns a hash of status, body, headers and url for marshalling if the response is finished, else nil.

Q58.summary: Collects class/module sketches from all trees and settles each through lineage and kinship analysis with ownership data, memoized.

Q59.summary: Flags `when` conditions in a case that are float expressions, except literal zero or nil.

Q60.summary: Runs the test suite as a baseline check and, if green with multiple jobs, also runs sharded parallel runs, returning status/message rows with failure advice.
